L154: ## Your timepiece reflects an expertise steeped in Tradition, Elegance and Performance. Endowed with a high technical know-how and expertise, our expert watchmakers work all over the world.​
L155: 
L156: From the most recent to the oldest pieces, from the simplest to the most complicated movements, from steel to jewelled watches, we take care of the timepieces entrusted to us with skill and care.​
